narrative.overview: The core landing page is a tactile Toronto financing file enlarged to architectural scale. Paper and field modes combine ink drawing, hard rules, practical underwriting language, electric-lime intervention, and Cult UI texture backgrounds. Brutalism is structural rather than careless: refinement comes from disciplined type, exact alignment, meaningful imagery, and controlled density.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-and-paper base with halftone, stipple, engraving, and screened Toronto imagery.
Electric lime as highlight, action, verification, route, and hard offset.
Blueprint blue, electric green, dark forest, ink, and ivory fields that rotate with Build Model progress.
Cult UI paper textures with theme-aware blend modes.
Brutalist deal files, attached callout slips, black rules, and dashed route arrows.

rules.name: The Root-Only Source Rule
rules.body: When another FairLend surface conflicts with the core landing page, the root implementation and supplied reference images win.

rules.name: The Worked-Paper Rule
rules.body: Texture must make a surface feel printed or handled without reducing readability.

rules.name: The Rotating Field Rule
rules.body: Build Model chapters may rotate only among Ivory, Blueprint Blue, Electric Lime, Field Forest, and Ink, and only for real narrative state changes.

rules.name: The Lime Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Lime must indicate action, active state, progress, verification, highlighted evidence, or a physical offset layer.

rules.name: The Hard-Edge Rule
rules.body: Deal files and callouts use a border or hard offset, never decorative wide ambient card shadows.

rules.name: The Motion Means Progress Rule
rules.body: Motion must trace, open, compare, verify, advance, fund, or complete something meaningful.

dos: Do treat the supplied Supacode screenshots and the root implementation as the visual source of truth.
Do rotate field colors only when the Build Model narrative state changes.
Do use Cult UI texture variants with theme-aware opacity, inversion, and blend mode.
Do retain black rules, square corners, hard offsets, attached evidence slips, and dashed route arrows.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast, visible focus, practical touch targets, and reduced-motion equivalents.
donts: Don't use navy-and-gold bank cliches or generic AI finance landing-page grammar.
Don't soften the brutalist file system into glass cards, pill-heavy SaaS UI, or ghost cards.
Don't use the field palette as an automatic carousel or decorative color cycle.
Don't place texture above body copy, controls, or focus indicators.
Don't use dashed arrows as filler or animate them endlessly.
